summary: The plural לוּדִים names a people descended from Mizraim. Both genealogies list the Ludim immediately before the Anamim.

senses.definition: A member of the people whom the genealogy traces to Mizraim.

evidence.note: לוּדִים is the first plural object of יָלַד after the subject מִצְרַיִם.
The genealogy again names the Ludim and then the Anamim among Mizraim’s descendants.
